issues.on_page: State Receipts: MIRF 4,423.78 (General Fund), a separate row from line 8 Highway Allocation and Incentives
issues.issue: [fixed: detail_category other state aid] MIRF (Municipal Infrastructure Redevelopment Fund) is not highway allocation. The form prints it as its own row. Under the 2026-11-12 ruling, state lines stay other state aid unless highway allocation is printed.

issues.on_page: Public Works - Other 2,164.03 (General Fund); streets are printed on their own row, line 32 Public Works - Streets
issues.issue: The form keeps Public Works - Other separate from Streets, so streets/highways is a guess. The business-type cells of the same row went to utilities. Same for detail[9].
Utility and sewer spending printed on a governmental public safety row is recorded as public safety for business-type, as printed (also detail[29] and detail[37]). Questionable for utility funds.

issues.on_page: Electric Utility (line 44) General 14,061.62 + Street 620.00; Water (line 48) General 704.03
issues.issue: Rows printed under Business-Type Activities but in governmental fund columns are kept governmental with category utilities (by column). Defensible, but these may be electricity and water bills for governmental operations.

issues.extracted: context label (Transportation); decided by context check
issues.issue: There is no output/json/_meta/context_decisions/Marquette_FY2022.csv, so these lines have not been context-checked yet even though the review text says they have. Category other is fine for now (context label). This covers disbursements[9], [17] and detail[14], [28], [33].

issues.extracted: Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways / Capital Outlay: Utilities
issues.issue: Capital outlay functions come from fund names (marked computed). The 2026-11-12 FY2022 ruling says a function is given only when printed. This covers disbursements[5], [14] and detail[24], [30], [38].
